turns.text: Hello, hi. Euh, I want to change my flight to Paris, s'il vous plaît.
Happy to help. Could I have your booking code and last name?
Thank you, Ms. Dubois, I found your booking on SK312 Saturday at 19:15. What change would you like?
Euh, I would like something plus tôt. Earlier. Le matin, if possible.
Sure. On Saturday I can only see what's in our system, so which day do you want to travel, and is a morning flight what you want?
Alors, same Saturday. Le matin, in the morning.
The morning flight to Paris is SK310 at 09:00, at 430 dollars. Your Economy fare is 445, so there's no extra fare, but there's a 75 dollar change fee.
Euh, 75 dollars? Why is there a fee? I booked three weeks ago.
Because Economy changes made after 24 hours of booking carry a 75 dollar fee. Flex fares have no fee.
Hmm, alors, okay. Then yes, please, I take the 09:00.
Done. I've moved you to SK310 on Saturday at 09:00 for a 75 dollar fee, and there's no fare difference. Anything else?
